## Seed filter
```
python3 tools/opps.py seed --grade [GRADE] --home [HOME_COUNTRY] [--field ...] --cost [any|free|no-paid]
python3 tools/opps.py seed --grade [GRADE] --home [HOME_COUNTRY] --abroad     # only if open to going abroad
```
